name: Adamas AX nut-fastened rear hub
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 389 g for the nut-fastened, solid-axle, 36-hole rear FH-AD61 hub, 124 mm OLD, excluding sprockets. The manufacturer drawing confirms hub nuts and no quick-release skewer. Nuts and axle hardware are not subtracted.
